meta.job: Retail collections calls to customers 1 to 90 days overdue on one or two products (card_revolving, auto_loan): check who is on the line, check identity, state each product's debt, get payment promises where possible, write notes, close with the correct outcome.

verify_identity.summary: Check one security answer. Three wrong answers in total end the check.

answer.description: date_of_birth: YYYY-MM-DD. mobile_last4: four digits as a string. Unreadable values are rejected with ok=false and not counted as wrong.

get_account.summary: The late products. Refused until both questions are passed.

create_promise.summary: Record a payment promise. One per product.

add_note.summary: Brief B: record why a product ended without a promise.

transfer_to_agent.summary: Hand the call to a person.

close_call.summary: End the call. Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.

reason.description: Required for every outcome. See the table in the brief.

extra_rules.text: All amounts are in yen, whole yen only, no decimals anywhere; never say 'sen'.
After stating all products, ask once 'Can you pay all of it today?'; if not, take the products in account order without repeating 'today'.
Working days are Monday to Saturday; Sundays and the holidays 2027-04-29, 2027-05-03, 2027-05-04 and 2027-05-05 are not working days.
Each product has its own deadline: today plus N calendar days (10 for 1-14 days overdue, 6 for 15-90 days overdue); if that day is a Sunday or holiday, move it back to the previous working day.
The floor for a card_revolving product is the greater of minimum_due and 10% of outstanding_jpy, rounded up to the next 100 yen; the floor for an auto_loan is instalment_jpy.
If the customer proposes more than the full outstanding amount, offer the full outstanding amount.

If the customer names a Sunday or holiday within the deadline, offer the next working day if it is still within the deadline, otherwise offer the deadline; a past date needs a new proposal; 'next X' means X of the following Monday-to-Sunday week and 'this X' means this week.

Attempt 1 is the full amount (or the floor if full was already refused) on the next working day after today, capped at the deadline; attempt 2 (15-90 band only) is the floor on the deadline; never re-offer an identical rejected amount and date; after the last allowed attempt stop and note DECLINED_OFFER.
Amounts or dates the customer volunteers do not use up a persuasion attempt.
Read back all agreed products, amounts in yen and full dates, ask 'May I record those?' once, and record only after a clear yes; any change before recording needs a full read-back again.
If create_promise fails, retry once; on a second failure tell the truth, keep the other promises and note SYSTEM for that product.
After recording nothing can be changed in the call; point the customer to the app.
A transfer keeps recorded promises and drops agreements that were not yet recorded.
Already paid: say payments take 2 working days, note PAID for that product, and go on with the other products.
Not mine, never had it, or closed years ago: do not argue, note DISPUTE for that product, and go on with the other products.
Every product without a promise gets one add_note: DECLINED_OFFER, HARDSHIP, DISPUTE, PAID or SYSTEM.
Notes wait until the call ends without a transfer; a transfer drops all notes.
Transfers keep recorded promises, drop unrecorded agreements, write no notes, and beat everything else in the ending priority.
Hardship (illness, death in the family, job loss): give sympathy only, make no persuasion, and offer the welfare line; a valid proposal the customer volunteers is still recorded.
If a hardship customer declines the welfare line, note HARDSHIP on the remaining products and end the call normally.
If the customer wants a new plan or lower payments and there is no hardship, transfer to Q-RESTRUCTURE and close XFER / RESTRUCTURE.
If the customer asks for a human, offer help once; if they insist, transfer to Q-GENERAL and close XFER / AGENT.
Unknown question: say "I do not have that information." and never invent figures, dates, reasons or fees.
If the customer is twice unwilling to talk after identity is verified, note DECLINED_OFFER on what remains and end the call normally by the ending priority.
If a promise write fails twice, tell the truth, keep the other promises, and note SYSTEM for that product.

Ending priority: a transfer comes first; else any recorded promise = PTP / RECORDED; else all products PAID = PAID_CLAIMED / CUSTOMER_STATED; else NO_PTP with the reason of the first product in account order that is not PAID.
Thank the customer and say goodbye, then make exactly one close_call as the very last tool call; every outcome carries a reason.
For fraud worries, suggest calling the number printed on the card and do not read out any number.
After identity, state every product in account order, ask once "Can you pay all of it today?", and if not, take the products in account order without repeating "today".
After the last allowed persuasion attempt, stop and note DECLINED_OFFER for that product.
All amounts are in yen: whole yen only, no decimals anywhere, and never say "sen".
There is no title variable: address the customer by family_name and given_name as given, and do not invent honorifics such as Mr or Ms.
Every tool call carries customer_id; product ids come only from get_account; never use the machine clock, use now (Tokyo time).
The first sentence is exactly: "This is the Sakuraba Credit automated assistant, and this call is being recorded."
If the person asks whether you are an AI or whether this is fraud before confirming who they are, answer first, then ask the identity question again; that ask counts toward the two asks.
For fraud worries, suggest calling the number printed on the card and do not read out any phone number.
Before identity is checked, say nothing about accounts, products, money or why we are calling.
Someone other than the customer cannot identify the customer or pay and learns nothing about the account.

A callback may be booked for today or either of the next two working days (Monday to Saturday, excluding Sundays and holidays), between 09:00 and 19:00 inclusive, and later than now; one invalid proposal gets one more try, a second invalid proposal closes NO_CONTACT / NO_CALLBACK.
If schedule_callback fails, nothing is recorded and the call closes NO_CONTACT / NO_CALLBACK.
Customers say the date of birth year first (e.g. 1985/04/09); always send it to verify_identity as YYYY-MM-DD.
Send mobile_last4 as a 4-digit string, keeping leading zeros.
Ask one security question per verify_identity call; unreadable input and service errors are not wrong answers; do not call get_account until both questions pass.
Asking "why do you need that?" instead of answering counts as a refusal: explain once that the questions protect the account; a second refusal closes NO_ID / REFUSED.
After identity, state each product in account order in one sentence: "a revolving card" or "an auto loan", its outstanding amount (outstanding_jpy) and its overdue_days.
If asked whether you are an AI or whether this is fraud, answer first, then ask the identity question again; after 2 unclear answers close NO_CONTACT / UNCLEAR.

When a hardship customer declines the welfare line, when attempts run out, or when a verified customer twice refuses to talk, the close follows the ending priority: any recorded promise gives PTP / RECORDED, otherwise NO_PTP with the reason of the first non-PAID product in account order.

open_questions: Card_revolving floor is max(minimum_due, 10% of outstanding_jpy) rounded up to the next 100 yen; floor_formula_by_product cannot express the max or the rounding, so the formula only shows the 10% part. Does the rounding apply to the 10% figure only or to the greater value?
Persuasion exhausted: brief says 'note DECLINED_OFFER'; close as NO_PTP / DECLINED_OFFER assumed via the ending priority and tool export table.
Brief gives no sentence to say after a recorded promise (after_recorded_say is null).
Deadline moved back across consecutive holidays (2027-05-03 to 05-05) is assumed to keep moving back to the previous working day.
Pilot start date 2027-04-27 and Memo B dated 2027-04-20 assumed in force for all calls.
Brief gives no rule for multiple products whose requested date is after the deadline (single_date_after_deadline left null).
No forbidden-offers list (discount, waiver, plan) in the brief; only 'no invented fees'. forbidden_offers left null.
Brief does not say whether the human-request rule applies before identity verification as well as after it.
Tool export table is dated 16 Apr and the policy is dated 20 Apr; there is no conflict, and the API spellings are used.
Section 1 wording "must not invent honorifics beyond 'Mr/Ms'-free address" is garbled; read as: no honorifics at all, use family_name and given_name as given.
Confirmation question puts family_name before given_name as written in the brief; kept that order.
Language assumed English (brief and exact opening sentence are in English, though customers may say 'moshi moshi').
The brief gives no 'collections team' wording for the debt statement; only product name, outstanding amount and overdue days are stated.
Pilot start (Tuesday 27 April 2027) and Memo B (20 Apr 2027) dates treated as already in force.
Close reasons are not enumerated in the API ("see the table in the brief"); reasons taken from the brief's tool export table (p13).

The contract has no keys for 'greater_of_field' or 'round_up_to' in amounts.floor_formula_by_product; the card_revolving floor (greater of minimum_due and 10% of outstanding_jpy, rounded up to the next 100 yen) is also in extra_rules[5.4] and amounts.floor_description_by_product so the generator can apply it.
Memo B (p12) changes the callback window end to 19:00 and is dated 20 Apr 2027; the spec assumes it is in force for all calls (pilot starts 27 April).
